name: Orbit AI - Phase 6 - Support ticketing intake (W6.2)

nodes.name: Support ticket webhook
nodes.notes: W6.2: 'Support ticketing intake... Auto to intake/route; human resolves (per humans stay on... support).' Called by portal/netlify/functions/submit-support-ticket.mts (portal/public/support.html's form). Input: {opportunityId (nullable), contactName (nullable), contactEmail, subject, message}. Server-side-validated a second time here even though the Netlify function already checks - same 'belt and suspenders, don't trust a client-side-only check' reasoning as portal-esign-submitted.workflow.json.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: false, reason: 'contactEmail, subject, and message are all required.' }) }}

nodes.name: Create SupportTicket

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ opportunityId: $json.body.opportunityId || null, contactName: $json.body.contactName || null, contactEmail: $json.body.contactEmail, subject: $json.body.subject, message: $json.body.message, status: 'Open', createdAt: new Date().toISOString() }) }}

nodes.notes: New object this pass, CRM-OBJECT-MODEL.md's SupportTicket - status starts 'Open', a human works it from there (this workflow does nothing else to it; there's no auto-resolution path anywhere in this repo, matching 'humans stay on... support' verbatim).

nodes.name: Alert: support ticket opened

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ severity: 'warning', source: 'support-ticket', message: 'New support ticket from ' + $('Support ticket webhook').item.json.body.contactEmail + ': ' + $('Support ticket webhook').item.json.body.subject, linkUrl: $('Support ticket webhook').item.json.body.opportunityId ? (($env.TWENTY_CRM_BASE_URL || '') + '/objects/opportunity/' + $('Support ticket webhook').item.json.body.opportunityId) : null }) }}

nodes.notes: Routes to #cx-retention - alertRouting.ts's cx-retention route extended this pass to match 'support-ticket' alongside 'referral-trigger'/'health-scoring'/'tier-upgrade'/'churn'/'cx-'. severity:'warning', not 'info' - an open, unrouted client support need is worth surfacing more prominently than a routine automated draft, since a human hasn't seen it yet at all.

nodes.name: Respond: created

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, ticketId: ($('Create SupportTicket').item.json.data || $('Create SupportTicket').item.json).id }) }}

nodes.notes: portal/netlify/functions/lib/submitSupportTicket.ts requires ticketId in this response and fails cleanly if it is missing - handles both the {data:{...}} and bare-object Twenty CRM response shapes, same uncertainty as everywhere else in this repo.
